description: Current holdings of a Cardano wallet: ADA balance, native tokens with balances (decimal-adjusted) and their value in ADA and USD, total portfolio value and trades in the last 24 h. Accepts a payment address (addr1…), a stake address (stake1…, all its addresses combined) or an ADA Handle ($name).

limit.description: How many positions, largest value first, to return (1-50, default 15).

name: get_wallet
title: Wallet balances
